annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised standards under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds, replaces, withdraws and corrects standard references, including EN ISO 3691-4:2023 for driverless industrial trucks, EN ISO 13849-1:2023 and ISO 25119 for agricultural machinery control systems, conferring presumption of conformity.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds EN ISO 3691-4:2023 (driverless industrial trucks) to the list of harmonised standards
Replaces EN ISO 13849-1:2015 with the 2023 version on safety-related control systems
Publishes EN 15194 and EN 15700 references with restrictions
Defers withdrawal of superseded standards to give manufacturers time to adapt
Corrects the type classification of EN 1127-2 and EN ISO 11554; in force on publication
